role: Development Gate-B settlement owner for a fixed 50:50 Directional plus Calendar-Spread oil portfolio. It assigns deterministic internal-cross fills, executes only residual external named-contract orders, returns fills to Strategy Books, attributes strategy trading PnL, and submits one reconciled statement to the Formal Account.
invariants: starting Formal Account named-contract positions equal the aggregation of the two starting Strategy Books
strategy capital authorization is fixed 50:50 only in this development mode
pre-trade allocation is completed before fills are created
internal cross uses the decision-cutoff named-contract mark known to both strategies
both sides of one internal cross receive exactly the same transfer price
internal cross consumes no external market turnover and creates no company-level trading PnL at transfer time
only residual net named-contract orders are sent to external execution
external execution schedule is frozen from pre-decision visible liquidity and later weekly OHLC/volume cannot alter that schedule
v0.1 requires the neutral compatibility execution desk and full completion of the pre-trade external mandate
external fills are allocated back to strategies without changing the pre-trade strategy-owned deltas
Calendar Spread ending ordinary ownership remains one-to-one before any future lifecycle roll
strategy gross PnL equals starting-position mark-to-market plus fill-to-end-mark PnL
strategy execution cost is attributed only from the external fills allocated to that strategy
sum of strategy gross PnL equals company gross trading PnL
sum of strategy execution cost equals company execution cost
sum of strategy net trading PnL equals the Formal Account variation-margin trading statement
Formal Account cash and margin are settled exactly once
Strategy Books never own idle-cash interest, financing or independent margin
forced liquidation attribution is not invented; if the Formal Account forces liquidation this v0.1 settlement is not considered reconciled
calendar-spread pair identity changes require a later lifecycle/roll owner and may not erase old Strategy Book positions
no market write-back occurs
